title: Define retry telemetry shaping and idempotency schema for multi-region failover
creator: Ava Martínez
description: Problem statement: Our current retry/timeout/backoff practices vary across services and SDKs which makes multi-region failover behavior unpredictable, increases operational cost, and pollutes observability with inconsistent telemetry. During the last regional incident (incident/2026-01-r1-failover) teams observed noise from unmanaged hedged requests and duplicate downstream side-effects when clients retried non-idempotent calls. We need a standardized contract for: (1) idempotency key semantics and header names, (2) a small hedged-request opt-in surface and limits, (3) SLO-aware retry budgets and backoff shaping, (4) consistent telemetry fields and sampling rules so SLIs and debugging are actionable across regions. This ticket defines the schema, SDK surface changes, and rollout plan.
acceptance_criteria: Idempotency header standardized to X-RWD-Idempotency-Key with spec for TTL and collision handling
Retry policy DSL defined and implemented in runtime core with parameters: max_attempts, base_backoff_ms, jitter, max_backoff_ms, retry_budget_key
Hedged request opt-in flag implemented at SDK (hedge=true) and gateway respects global per-customer hedge_max_fanout
Circuit breaker integration documented: retries respect CB open/half-open states and adapt retry_budget from circuit state
Telemetry shape standardized and emitted by runtime and SDK: fields for retry_reason, attempt_index, hedged=true/false, idempotency_seen, region_targeted
Dashboard: cross-region SLO breakdown by SLO-class (low/standard/high) and retry-induced errors visible in staging and canary
Backward-compatible: existing clients without idempotency header continue to function; non-idempotent operations must opt-out of automatic retries
decisions: Use single well-known header X-RWD-Idempotency-Key rather than multiple header variants to reduce parsing complexity in runtime proxies
Default SDK behavior: no automatic retries for non-idempotent routes unless explicit idempotency key or explicit opt-in (safe_retry=true) provided
Introduce SLO-class token buckets (retry budgets) per customer+route that throttle retries when SLO budget is exhausted to avoid amplification during regional degradation
Hedged requests are opt-in at SDK and gated by a tenant-level quota (hedge_max_fanout) enforced by gateway to prevent fanout storms
Telemetry will be sparse-sampled for successful retries (1%) and full-sampled for failures and hedged requests to control cardinality while preserving debugging fidelity
tradeoffs_and_risks: Stricter idempotency requirements reduce accidental duplication but add developer burden to mark operations safe or generate keys
Retry budgeting will lower amplification in outages but may increase visible error rates for customer requests when budgets are exhausted; requires clear comms
Hedged requests reduce tail latency but increase upstream load; improper defaults may cause cascading overload in multi-region failover
Telemetry schema changes risk increasing cardinality; we mitigate with sampling, tag coalescing (bucketizing attempt_index) and controlled rollout
implementation_notes: Runtime: add RetryPolicy DSL module (core/runtime/retry_policy.go) with pluggable budget lookup and telemetry hooks
Gateway: enforce hedge_max_fanout and honor X-RWD-Idempotency-Key presence during routing and fallback decisions
SDKs (js/python/go): expose RetryPolicy builder, auto-gen idempotency keys when operation annotated @safe_idempotent, and hedged_request boolean
Circuit-breaker: PBQ (per-customer) retry_budget consumed on each additional attempt; CB open state prevents retries altogether; half-open permits single retry token
Observability: add labels retry_reason:{timeout,server_error,overloaded}, attempt_index:{1,2,3+}, hedged:{true,false}, idempotency_present:{yes,no}
rollout_plan: Week 1: Merge runtime + gateway changes behind feature flag feature/retry-schema; SDKs publish alpha with opt-in hedged API
Week 2: Canary traffic in us-east-1 for internal services (token service, embeddings), monitor retry SLI, downstream duplicate events dashboard
Week 3: Expand to two-region dual write experiments with hedged=false defaults; test SLO-class budget exhaustion behavior in controlled failure
Week 4: Gradual enablement for PLG customers with communication and client migration guides; enable full telemetry sampling for failures only
Fallback: revert toggle at gateway-level if retry-induced amplification > 1.5x baseline
follow_up_tasks: ENG-xxxxx: Implement idempotency key TTL eviction policy in KV cache and document expected collision semantics
ENG-xxxxx: Add SDK linting rule to warn when a network-altering API is used without explicit idempotency key or safe_retry flag
PM-42000: Publish customer migration guide and notification plan for PLG users
DES-3071: Update console UX to surface retry budget consumption per-route and allow per-tenant override for hedge_max_fanout
